document.title: Exercise of an Incentive Stock Option Under Section 422(b)
document.issued_by: employer (or transfer agent) whose stock was transferred on exercise of an ISO

boxes.label: CORRECTED (if checked)
boxes.notes: Marks this statement as correcting one already furnished for the same year.

boxes.label: VOID
boxes.notes: Printed on Copy A only; a filer's mark, never a figure.

boxes.label: Account number (see instructions)
boxes.notes: The filer's own account number; identification only.

boxes.label: Fair market value per share on exercise date
If other than TRANSFEROR, name, address, and TIN of corporation whose stock is being transferred

document.notes: Basis information, not income: an ISO exercise is not regular income in the year of exercise; gain or loss is reported in the year the stock is sold. The spread (box 4 less box 3, times box 5) may be an AMT adjustment on Form 6251 line 2i — a computation.

extraction.note: No structured model is bound: no Azure prebuilt-tax model for this form is recorded anywhere in this repo (schema, notes or the 068 model re-verification), and a model name is never guessed. The page is read by the generic reader.
